metadata.title: Secure Workload Platform

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating application workloads with consistent security, governance, and trust guarantees across execution platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Application workloads across containers, virtual machines, PaaS services, and serverless platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that workloads are deployed, governed, and operated under consistent trust controls.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Privilege escalation within or between workloads.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of workload identities or service principals.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Separation of duties and workload identity governance.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Centralized visibility and monitoring of workload behavior.

metadata.remarks: Secure Workload Platform is a composite trust pattern asserting that application workloads are governed, isolated, authorized, monitored, and constrained regardless of execution substrate. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for SSPPs and solution architectures.
